caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular black metal wood stove with a chimney pipe extending vertically from the top and then turning at a right angle into the wall. The stove sits on four legs, with a flat, rectangular metal base beneath it. On the left side of the stove's front is a circular metal plate with a handle. The room has light brown wooden floorboards and light-colored walls, with a shadow cast by the stove. In the corner, there is a tall wooden cabinet with two doors on top and a drawer and door section beneath, all in a warm reddish-brown color. A wooden baseboard runs along the wall and a wooden coat rail with pegs is mounted on the left side near the ceiling. The stove and cabinet are placed close to the corner of the room, with the stove positioned slightly in front and toward the right of the cabinet.
title: Shaker Stove/Built-in Closet
